title: Which value wins
sub: The same one, everywhere, a series on master and reference data: HMS Beagle's twenty-two clocks, and which one to trust; Linh's records, linked to one person and still disagreeing; one order for every field, hidden in the code, and why the newest value isn't the truest; her legal name and the name she chose; a rule for each field, declared in one place and tested; four emails, each kept for what it's for; every value with its source; a rule change seen before it runs; and the same question at a bank and a shop.
howto: The film is drawn in watercolour. Each source wears its role's colour: the student system teal, HR violet, the research office coral, the alumni office green; Linh, as a source of her own details, is the white of the paper. Cyan edges the technical side, gold the business side, and red ink marks the error.
